item.description:
### Changed - **The menu-bar thinking word changes every 10 seconds instead of every 3.** Each change made macOS redraw the menu bar, and while an agent was working that redraw was most of the work Perch did. The word still rotates, just more calmly.
### Improved - **Perch uses less CPU in the background.** Looking up which agents are running used to re-read every process on the Mac every four seconds. It now remembers what it has already read and only looks again when a process changes, which makes each check about nine times faster.
